## Overview

Cycling is an often-overlooked mode of transport for both commuting and recreation, and one that has grown in popularity — while being environmentally friendly, economical, and healthy. This project builds probabilistic models of cycling-accident risk, using Greater Manchester as a case study.

## Notes

- Spatial risk modelling across the Greater Manchester road network.
- Communicating uncertainty in a way that's useful for policy and planning.
